## Resizable.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `orientation` :: The direction panes are laid out: `horizontal` puts them side by side, `vertical` stacks them.
- `sizes` :: The size of every pane in percent, in order. Bindable; reads and writes stay in step with dragging.
- `onResize` :: Called with the new sizes (percent, in order) whenever the user moves a handle.
- `storageKey` :: Saves the layout to `localStorage` under this key and restores it on the next visit.
- `children` :: The panes and the handles between them.

## ResizableHandle.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `withGrip` :: Draws a small grip on the handle so it reads as draggable.
- `surface` :: The surface of that grip chip. @default 'elevated'
- `textColor` :: The ink of the grip glyph. @default 'text-muted'

### `const index`

Handle n sits after pane n — read from the DOM once mounted, so late panes keep it right.

## ResizablePane.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `defaultSize` :: The starting size in percent. Panes without one share what the others leave.
- `minSize` :: The smallest size in percent the pane may be dragged to.
- `maxSize` :: The largest size in percent the pane may be dragged to.
- `collapsible` :: Lets the pane collapse to `collapsedSize` when dragged past its minimum, or toggled with Enter on its handle.
- `collapsedSize` :: The size in percent the pane rests at when collapsed. `0` hides it entirely.
- `collapsed` :: Whether the pane is collapsed. Bindable; set it to open or close the pane with a spring.
- `children` :: The pane's content.

## resizable.svelte.ts

### `interface PaneEntry`

What a pane tells its group about itself. Getters keep the values live.

- `el` :: The pane element — set once mounted; used to keep panes in document order.

### `const floor`

The lowest size a pane may rest at: its collapsed size if it can collapse, else its minimum.

### `const isCollapsedSize`

Whether a size means the pane is collapsed.

### `function fitOne`

Bring one size into a pane's allowed set: collapsed, or within [min, max].

### `function snap`

Resolve a drag/keyboard target for a pane, collapsing past the halfway point to the collapsed size.

### `function fit`

Make a set of sizes honour every pane's limits and total exactly 100.

### `function resolve`

Sizes from the explicit overrides, then each pane's default, then an equal share of what is left.

### `class ResizableState`

The state shared by a `Resizable` group, its panes and its handles.

- `dragging` :: A pointer is dragging a handle — panes follow it directly instead of springing.
- `touched` :: The user has moved something (as opposed to the sizes being defaults or seeded).
- `sizes` :: The current sizes, in percent, in document order.
- `defaults` :: The sizes with no user input.
- `sort` :: Re-order panes by their position in the document (after a pane mounts late).
- `nextHandle` :: The ordinal of a handle at registration — the fallback until it can read its place in the DOM.
- `describe` :: The pane before the handle at this gap, and the size/limits a separator reports.
- `seed` :: Seed sizes (a bound value or storage) without counting as user input.
- `apply` :: Record sizes the user chose.
- `available` :: Pixels available to panes along the group's axis (the group minus its handles).
- `move` :: Sizes after moving the handle at `index` by `delta` percent from `base`.
- `resizeBy` :: Move the handle at `index` by `delta` percent from where it is now.
- `jump` :: Put the pane before the handle at `index` at its smallest or largest size.
- `reset` :: Return the two panes around a handle to their default proportions.
- `setCollapsed` :: Collapse or expand a pane, springing its neighbour to take or give the space.
- `toggleAt` :: Toggle whichever pane around a handle can collapse (an already-collapsed one opens first).
